_comment: Site options. aboutPhoto: which synced gallery image to use in the About section - an Instagram post id from gallery/manifest.json (e.g. "17912345678901234") or a filename in gallery/ (e.g. "17912345678901234.jpg"); leave empty for the placeholder. curation: the AI gallery picker - model is the Claude model used to decide painting vs. not; newestGuaranteed is how many of your newest paintings always get a spot regardless of likes.
